description: TTA library inference/tta.py (design 2.1-2.7, 3.1, 5, 7.2, 7.4), the pre-change T9 golden (review NIT 1), and the TTA term of the host-store estimate (design 6, T11). No runner/CLI integration yet: the default code path is untouched by this feature except the new keyword of estimate_store_gb.
steps: 0. Create .agents/tasks/tta/run_tests.sh (bash, LF line endings): cd to /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad; `source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh; set +u`; mode `tf <unittest names...>`: conda activate tf_gpu, export TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512 BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000 TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, run `python -m unittest <names> -v 2>&1 | grep -v 'cuBLAS factory'` and exit with python's status (PIPESTATUS); mode `py38 <names...>`: conda activate bgr_preproc38, run unittest, then assert 'tensorflow' not in sys.modules (python -c wrapper as in tests/run_tests_wsl.sh stage 1); mode `compile`: bgr_preproc38 `python -m py_compile` + `ast.parse(feature_version=(3, 8))` over inference/*.py evaluation/*.py scripts/compare_tta.py (if present) predict.py tests/test_tta*.py tests/test_predict_tta*.py tests/test_linear_eval.py tests/test_compare_tta.py (existing ones only); mode `bashn <files>`: bash -n each; mode `script <path.py>`: run a python file in tf_gpu with the same env. BGR_WRITE_GOLDEN and BGR_DEFER_MEMORY_TESTS are inherited when exported by the caller (`BGR_WRITE_GOLDEN=1 bash run_tests.sh tf ...` from inside `wsl -d Ubuntu bash -c`). Invoke from PowerShell as `wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.agents/tasks/tta/run_tests.sh tf tests.test_tta`.

1. BEFORE editing any source file (tree must equal HEAD 19b8a60 apart from .agents/): write tests/test_predict_tta_golden.py (imports tests.tf_setup first; uses tests.predict_helpers save_level4_run / save_cascade_run / write_subjects, tests.runtime_helpers.tiny_config, tests.test_cascade STAGE_KW / randomize, tests.test_trainer._OpDeterminism, and the level-2 cascade construction of tests/test_predict.py TestLevel2Convention.setUpClass lines 686-702: m4 randomize seed 3, FrozenStage.from_model, m2 copy_weights_from + randomize seed 4, save_cascade_run). setUpClass: tmp dir, 3 textured subjects (write_subjects(proc, 3, textured=True, seed=11)), level-4 ckpt (save_level4_run(tmp, 'l4', tiny_config(**STAGE_KW), seed=5)) and the level-2 cascade ckpt. For ckpt in (l4, l2) x branches (rigid, deform, affine+deform): `PR.run_predict(PR-style argv via cli.parse_args(['run', '--checkpoint', ck, '--processed-dir', proc, '--out', out, '--branches', b, '--tta', 'none', '--store', 'ram', '--check-internal', '0']), configure_device=False)` inside _OpDeterminism; hash (sha256) for every *.nii.gz in sorted order `np.asarray(nib.load(p).dataobj).tobytes() + nib.load(p).affine.tobytes()` (NOT file bytes) and, in-process, `inference.loader.load_model(ck, b, precision='checkpoint', device='gpu')` + `StreamedRunner(loaded, RamStore()).run(images, b)` summary['A'] as float64 bytes for rigid / affine+deform. Keys '<level>/<branch>/<file>' and '<level>/<branch>/A'. With BGR_WRITE_GOLDEN=1 write tests/fixtures/predict_tta_off_golden.json (sort_keys, plus 'commit' = git HEAD, 'mode' = 'hash', 'tolerance' = 0) else compare key set and every hash. Step 0 of review NIT 1: run it with BGR_WRITE_GOLDEN=1, then again without: must pass. If enable_op_determinism raises for a prediction op: set os.environ TF_CUDNN_DETERMINISTIC=1 / TF_DETERMINISTIC_OPS=1 at the module top (before tests.tf_setup) instead and repeat. If two unchanged-tree runs still differ: switch the module to 'mode' = 'inprocess': keep a verbatim copy of today's StreamedLevel.deform body as `_LegacyDeformLevel(StreamedLevel).deform` in the test module and compare legacy vs current runner outputs with max |diff| == 0 in one process. Record which rule was used in the fixture and in the test log.

2. Create inference/tta.py (module docstring citing design 2-5, 7.2; numpy-only module-level imports; TF imported inside functions). Contents: FLIPS_8 = tuple(itertools.product((False, True), repeat=3)) (identity first, (x, y, z) order); IDENTITY_ONLY = ((False, False, False),); MODES = ('none', 'flip8'); class TTAConfig(mode, levels, flips=FLIPS_8) with to_dict() -> {mode, levels: list, flips: [[fx, fy, fz] bools]}; LINEAR_AVERAGING = 'gauge-free residual, float64, eigh (Markley) read-out'; SVF_ACCUMULATION = 'float32'; SPREAD_COLUMNS = ('spread_rms_mm', 'spread_max_mm', 'spread_p99_mm', 'shift_mm', 'rot_deg_rms', 'trans_mm_rms', 'scale_pct_rms', 'shear_pct_rms', 'rot_gap', 'readout_dev_deg') (review NIT 3: spread_max_mm linear only, spread_p99_mm deform only); IU10 = ((0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(2,2),(2,3),(3,3)); flip_signs3(flip) -> float64 (f_x, f_y, f_z); linear_flip_signs(flip, task) derived by formula (S_q = (1, f_y f_z, f_x f_z, f_x f_y), entry signs s_i s_j over IU10, translation f, log-scales 1, shears (f_x f_y, f_x f_z, f_y f_z)); flip_matrix_np(flip) float64 [4,4]; unflip_matrices(M, flip) = F M F for numpy (float64/32 kept) or TF tensors; flip_np(x, flip) = np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(x, np.float32)[:, ::-1 on flipped axes 1..3]) for [k, X, Y, Z, C]; unflip_field(v, flip) (TF: tf.reverse on flipped spatial axes, multiply by the (f_x, f_y, f_z) sign vector cast to v.dtype; identity flip returns v unchanged); encode_linear(R, task) (float64 numpy, see FEAT acceptance), mean_linear(params_list) -> (p_bar float64 [N, 13|19], {'rot_gap': [N], 'readout_dev_deg': [N]}), decode_linear(p_bar, task) -> float32 [N, 4, 4] via tfm.rigid_matrix / tfm.affine_matrix in float64; linear_tta_level(M_flips, a_prev, centering, task, flips) implementing design 2.3 steps 3-9 (M_flips: list over flips of UNFLIPPED raw [N,4,4] float32 tensors/arrays; a_prev None or float32 [N,4,4]; centering = model.centering or any GroupCentering; identity-only flips -> exactly `tf.cast(centering(M), tf.float32)` / `CS.compose_linear(M, a_prev, centering)` without re-encoding; returns dict(A=float32 tensor, A_flips=list float64 numpy, params=list float64 [N,P], mean_diag, nonfinite=[flip indices with any non-finite row])); linear_spread(A_flips, A_bar, S, params_flips, p_bar, task) -> dict of per-image arrays for spread_rms_mm, spread_max_mm, shift_mm (A_flips[0] = identity flip), rot_deg_rms (runtime.metrics.qr_factors rotation factors and rotation_angle_deg of Q_f Q_bar^T), trans_mm_rms, scale_pct_rms / shear_pct_rms (affine only; |delta log-scale| x100 and |delta K_ab| x100 of the residual params); S may be [4,4] or per-image [N,4,4] (runtime.metrics.point_rms broadcasting); gauge_size(mu_flips) -> (deg, mm) = max_f of rotation angle / translation norm of inv(mu_0) mu_f (mu_f = tfm.barycenter float64 of M_f A_prev with the model's centering_iters, computed by a helper gauge_barycenters(M_flips, a_prev, iters)); summarize_spread(rows) -> {level/task: {column: {mean, median, p95, max}}}; train_flip_probs(chain) where chain = {level: (path or None, config dict or None)} -> {level: p or None} (p = args.flip_prob, 0.0 when args.overfit_one_group, None if config or the key is missing) and flip_prob_warnings(probs, tta_levels) -> list of WARNING strings (design 7.4 texts: p < 0.5 'flips partly out of training distribution', p == 0 'flips never seen in training; TTA averages out-of-distribution predictions', None 'training flip probability unknown'). Python 3.8 syntax.

3. inference/store.py: estimate_store_gb(level, model_cfg, n, branches, trainable_dtype='float16', tta_levels=()): inside the existing per-level loop, when the branch set has deform and lv in tta_levels, add 28 * vox (s1 12 V + s2 4 V + c0 12 V) to d before the max; nothing else changes (default result identical). Update the docstring (design 6).

4. tests/test_tta.py (imports tests.tf_setup first): TestSigns (T1/C3/C1/C2: JAY literal vectors from .agents/tasks/tta/check_flip_signs.py; all 8 combined == products; 64 random general 10-D params (p_rot normal + 2 x identity_rotation_10d) rigid and affine, float64 max |diff| < 1e-12, float32 < 1e-5, using tfm.flip_conjugate / tfm.flip_matrix), TestCentering (T2/C4 center_group(F A F) == F center_group(A) F, N 12 float64 < 1e-10), TestFields (T3/C5/C6: unflip_field involution bitwise; integrate_svf(v^F) vs (integrate_svf v)^F < 1e-5 vox; diffeo.warp(flip I, u^F) vs flip warp(I, u) < 1e-4; L.transform_image(flip I, F M F) vs flip transform_image(I, M) < 1e-4; flip_np equals tfm.flip_images numerically and is C-contiguous), TestEncoding (T4/E1/E2: decode(encode(M)) == M < 1e-12 float64 for 50 random rigid and affine; encode(F M F) == sigma_f * encode(M) < 1e-12 for 8 flips x 20; encode_linear shears equal K01, K02, K12 and differ from qr_factors ratios on a matrix with non-unit scales; rigid drops K), TestAveraging (C7: mean_linear of 8 identical encodings returns them < 1e-15 with rot_gap ~ 1; eigh read-out of the mean of rotations by +theta and -theta about one axis composed with a base rotation = the base rotation (< 1e-9 deg); readout_dev_deg > 0 for disagreeing rotations; float32 running sum of 8 identical fields / 8 within 2e-7 relative), TestGaugeFree (E3/E4/E5 ported from check_gauge_free.py onto tta.linear_tta_level with tfm.GroupCentering(iters=30, dtype='float64') and iters 4: v2 pairwise error < 1e-8 mm, the in-test v1 raw-averaging reference > 0.05 mm; equivariance TTA(flip_g x) vs F_g TTA(x) F_g < 1e-8 for g in x, y, z, xyz with a non-equivariant random group; 4-iteration pair error < 1e-8 mm and centered translation diff < 1e-5 mm; identity-only flips return exactly the two-line result, max |diff| 0; N = 2 works), TestDiagnostics (T8: linear_spread with known per-flip offsets: pure translation offsets +-d on 8 flips give spread_rms_mm = d (S = identity-like second moment), shift_mm known, rot_deg_rms for known rotations, gauge_size of mu_f = rotations by known angles returns that max angle and translation), TestTrainFlip (T14: configs flip_prob 0.5 / 0.2 / 0 / overfit_one_group true / unreadable (None) -> 0.5 / 0.2 / 0 / 0 / None and the expected warning strings; no warning for 0.5).

5. tests/test_predict_store.py TestEstimate: new test_tta_term (TF-free): for every level 4/2/1 and branches deform / affine+deform / rigid: tta_levels=() equals the call without the keyword exactly; deform with tta_levels=(lv,) adds exactly 28 * prod(LEVEL_SHAPE[lv]) * n / 1e9 when that level is the max term (check level 1 N 101 default widths: estimate grows by 28 * 6881280 * 101 / 1e9 = 19.46 GB) and rigid is unaffected; affine+deform with TTA keeps one src_affine term (difference to deform+TTA equals the difference without TTA).
6. inference/__init__.py docstring: add a `tta` bullet (TF-free import surface; flips, sign vectors, gauge-free linear averaging, SVF unflip, diagnostics).

7. Write .agents/tasks/tta/test-log-FEAT-001.md: every command run (golden write + compare on the unchanged tree with timestamps and the determinism rule used, then test_tta, test_predict_tta_golden, test_predict_store, compile), the 'Ran N tests' / OK lines, skips, and the max diffs printed by the tests.

findings: Iteration 1 done (test log .agents/tasks/tta/test-log-FEAT-001.md). (1) T9 golden tests/fixtures/predict_tta_off_golden.json written on the unchanged tree (commit 19b8a608ca7e3d68693d842f53746b07ee00aff5), mode 'hash', tolerance 0, 70 hashes (l4/l2 x rigid/deform/affine+deform NIfTIs + 4 A entries); compare run on the same tree OK; passes again after the FEAT-001 edits. enable_op_determinism raised for no prediction op -> no fallback needed. Run time ~405 s per run of tests.test_predict_tta_golden. FEAT-002 must keep it passing after the _v_raw_passes split and runner/CLI changes (never regenerate it). (2) inference/tta.py API as specified, with these signatures for FEAT-002: linear_tta_level(M_flips, a_prev, centering, task, flips=FLIPS_8, dtype=None) -> dict(A tensor, A_flips list float64 [N,4,4] or None, params list float64 [N,P] or None, p_bar float64 or None, mean_diag {'rot_gap','readout_dev_deg'} or None, nonfinite list of flip indices); dtype default = a_prev.dtype or float32 at the first level (identity-only path = exactly tf.cast(centering(M), float32) / CS.compose_linear(M, a_prev, centering)); M_flips must already be UNFLIPPED (use tta.unflip_matrices(M, flip), which returns M itself for the identity flip). linear_spread(A_flips, A_bar, S, params_flips, p_bar, task, mean_diag=None) -> dict of [N] arrays (spread_rms_mm, spread_max_mm, shift_mm, rot_deg_rms, trans_mm_rms, + scale_pct_rms/shear_pct_rms for affine, + rot_gap/readout_dev_deg when mean_diag given; no spread_p99_mm: deform only); S [4,4] or [N,4,4]. gauge_barycenters(M_flips, a_prev, iters) -> list of float64 [4,4]; gauge_size(mu_flips) -> (deg, mm). summarize_spread(rows) keys 'l<level>/<task>'. decode_linear(p_bar, task, dtype=np.float32). flip_np(x, flip) float32 C-contiguous; unflip_field(v, flip) TF (identity returns v). train_flip_probs({level: (path, config)}) -> {level: p|None}; flip_prob_warnings(probs, tta_levels) -> strings 'TTA level %d: ...'. (3) store.estimate_store_gb(..., tta_levels=()) adds 28*vox at every TTA deform level before the max; default unchanged (checked against literal values of 19b8a60 for all 24 level/branch/dtype combos). NOTE for the report: design 6's '39.7 -> 59.2 GB' assumed level 1 is the max term; with the fp16 trainable stage the frozen fp32 level-2 term dominates, so the real estimate for d12hs widths N 101 is 39.70 -> 53.08 GB (default widths 44.74 -> 55.60); still < 72 GB (0.7 x 96G budget) -> RAM store. (4) .agents/tasks/tta/run_tests.sh modes tf/py38/compile/bashn/script as specified; compile includes the TF-free import check of inference.tta. (5) tests.test_tta takes ~5 min locally (float64 logm centerings), 33 tests.
